name: Lagoons of New Caledonia: Reef Diversity and Associated Ecosystems
story: The Lagoons of New Caledonia are located in New Caledonia in the South Pacific. The New Caledonian barrier reef surrounds Grande Terre and reaches a length of 1,500 kilometres. The reef encloses a lagoon of 24,000 square kilometres.
matters: The reef has great species diversity with a high level of endemism, hosting the third-largest population of endangered dugongs on Earth and serving as an important nesting site for green sea turtles.
